note: On-call water taxis (contract WaterTaxisPackage in src/timetable/types.ts). Only what each operator publishes on its own page, in English; a field it doesn't publish is null. Search results show a taxi when both piers are in `piers` (and one is in `oneEndAt`, when set) and the date is in `season`. Edit here, never in app code; a push to main publishes it. Recheck each entry against `source` and update `updated`.

taxis.name: Speedy Taxiboot
taxis.area: Anywhere on the lake, from its base in Brunnen
taxis.hours: Rides at any time, also at night; bookings by phone 09:00–18:00

taxis.name: Swiss Lake Twins
taxis.area: Anywhere on the lake, pickup at an agreed pier
taxis.price: Fare per route on the operator's page; after dusk +20%

taxis.name: Private Lake Lucerne
taxis.area: Around the lake, e.g. Luzern to Weggis, Vitznau or Bürgenstock
taxis.hours: April to October, around the clock

taxis.name: Sail and More
taxis.area: From Weggis to Vitznau, Beckenried, Kehrsiten, Luzern, Hertenstein and more

taxis.name: Wassertaxi Zürich
taxis.area: Zurich and the lake up to Schmerikon, wherever the boat can land
taxis.price: Shared ride in the Zurich basin from CHF 20 per person (at least CHF 60); private transfer in the basin CHF 140, to Küsnacht or Thalwil CHF 250, to Rapperswil CHF 680

taxis.name: Seetaxi Zürichsee
taxis.area: From Utoquai in Zurich to anywhere on the lake
taxis.hours: MS Rosa summer and winter; the sloop in summer only
taxis.price: CHF 380–450 per hour, at least one hour

taxis.name: Schiffstaxi
taxis.area: Pfäffikon or Rapperswil to the island of Ufenau
taxis.price: Pfäffikon–Ufenau and back CHF 9 per person; Rapperswil–Ufenau and back CHF 150 per trip

taxis.name: Wasser Taxi Hanhart
taxis.area: The Untersee and the Rhine: Schaffhausen, Stein am Rhein, Konstanz, Reichenau

taxis.name: Seetaxi Bregenz
taxis.hours: April to mid-October, daily from 09:00 to sunset, weather permitting

taxis.name: Ambra Taxi Nautico
taxis.area: The whole lake, from Porlezza to Ponte Tresa
taxis.hours: Every day, around the clock; cash only
taxis.price: From CHF 280 per hour, skipper and fuel included; +40% after midnight

taxis.name: Party Boat Lugano
taxis.area: From Lugano to Gandria, Caprino and Morcote
taxis.price: One way for 4 people: Caprino CHF 50, Gandria CHF 70, Morcote CHF 150; CHF 5 for each extra person

taxis.name: TAXIBOATS.ch
taxis.area: Pickup in Locarno, Ascona, Brissago, Tenero, Magadino and along the Gambarogno shore; as far as Cannobio
taxis.price: CHF 3 per minute of travel, CHF 1 per minute of waiting; +50% from 22:00, +100% from midnight
